meta.title: About us – learn by building real projects
meta.description: loop is a modern platform for learning programming through hands-on projects. Build your portfolio, learn technologies step by step, and grow your IT skills – no matter your experience level.

hero.title: Learn by building projects
hero.subtitle: a learning platform that teaches programming through building real-world projects. Each project has a clear goal, real technology, and a chance to develop your skills in practice.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.subtitle: We want to make learning to code accessible through action. We’re building a system of project-based paths that help you develop real skills step by step.

methods.name: Learning by doing
methods.description: Every project is a real-world problem to solve.

methods.name: Project dependencies
methods.description: Some projects require previous ones – that way you learn in the right order and avoid wasting time on unnecessary theory.

methods.name: Accessible at any level
methods.description: Projects for beginners, intermediate, and advanced learners – all broken into steps with clear instructions.

coreValues.title: Core values
coreValues.subtitle: At loop, we follow four key values that shape how we teach and support our community.

values.name: Accessibility
values.description: We believe learning to code should be available to everyone, regardless of background or experience.

values.name: Practicality
values.description: We focus on hands-on learning – you learn by coding, not just reading.

values.name: Innovation
values.description: We’re committed to modern teaching methods and constantly improving our platform to support you better.

values.name: Support
values.description: You’re not alone – you can count on support from mentors, the community, and clear step-by-step instructions.
